extDescription.message: A Clawdline measurement prototype. A test tool on this computer (127.0.0.1) can view and operate tabs. Nothing is sent elsewhere.

actionTitle.message: Clawdline Browser Probe: what it does and its status

popupBadge.message: Measurement prototype · not the released extension

statusConnected.message: Connected to the measurement tool on this computer

statusIdle.message: Not connected. This is normal when no measurement is running.

purposeBody.message: Clawdline is evaluating how an AI agent can use Chrome while you watch and take over. This prototype measures frame delay, data volume and click and typing accuracy, so that the design rests on real numbers.

does1.message: Acts only while the measurement tool on this computer is running and connected.

does2.message: On the tool's instruction, opens and switches tabs, captures the visible page, clicks and types.

does3.message: While it is attached to a tab, Chrome shows a bar saying the browser is being debugged. That bar is Chrome's own safeguard and cannot be hidden.

doesNot1.message: It connects to no server on the internet. Its only connection is 127.0.0.1 on this computer.

doesNot2.message: Its code does not read cookies, saved passwords or browsing history.

doesNot3.message: It is not the released Clawdline extension, and it is not connected to your Clawdline account or Cloud.

permDebugger.message: Debugger: captures the page image and sends clicks and keystrokes through the Chrome DevTools Protocol.

permTabs.message: Tabs: opens, lists and switches the tabs used in a measurement.

permSites.message: All sites: lets a measurement run on any test page.

removeBody.message: Open chrome://extensions, find Clawdline Browser Probe and choose Remove. Nothing else needs to be cleaned up.
